records.definition: Corroborate a person against named identity sources; return individual checks, matched fields and gaps.
Assess document authenticity and validity; state document type, issuer, expiry and the checks actually performed.
Return face/fingerprint comparison, liveness or presentation-attack findings with method, reference and thresholds; distinguish 1:1 from 1:N.
Corroborate an address using a named source and method; address parsing alone is insufficient.
Validate a digital-identity assertion, issuer, audience, trust scheme and assurance; session login alone is insufficient.
Validate a tax identifier in its issuer namespace and return any evidenced name/status match; syntax calculation is not validation.
Verify specified business facts against evidenced sources; registry retrieval alone is not a verified business outcome.
Retrieve a registered organization, status and filing references in an explicit registry namespace.
Return dated ownership/control edges, interest types, source and completeness; distinguish legal ownership, control and accounting parents.
Retrieve officer roles, appointments, resignations and disqualification facts with dates and source.
Match against explicitly named sanctions datasets and versions; return candidates and coverage, without a legal clearance decision.
Return political-exposure candidates, roles, relationships and time intervals under an explicit PEP definition.
Return attributed media findings with publication date, language and allegation/proceeding status; do not imply sanctions coverage.
Return regulator, court, debarment or enforcement candidates with action type and source; distinguish these from financial sanctions.
Screen payment parties and structured/unstructured payment fields under named lists and policy; not payment execution.
Return device identifiers, behavioral/integrity signals, observation times and provider scores; collection is a separate action.
Return email validity, reputation and linked-risk signals with observation times and score provenance.
Return telephone line, carrier, validity and risk signals; possession/OTP assurance must be explicitly evidenced.
Return network/IP location, proxy and reputation signals; geolocation is probabilistic and not residence verification.
Retrieve or assess country/jurisdiction risk under a named methodology, publisher and as-of date; separate publication authority from target country.
Return provider risk factors and scores with methodology, scale and input scope; preserve the institution decision separately.
Compare a named subject against account-holder evidence; return per-field comparisons, account namespace and match method.
Retrieve financial documents or extracted financial facts with institution, period, currency and provenance; not account ownership or transaction surveillance.
Evaluate fiat transaction activity under explicit scenarios/time windows and return alerts, observation coverage and rule versions.
Manage investigation cases, assignments, dispositions and audit history; this is an operational service contract.
Create, validate or submit regulator-specific reports; distinguish draft, submitted, acknowledged, accepted and rejected.
Return wallet attribution/exposure by chain, asset, counterparty and hop policy; a wallet address requires a chain namespace.
Return blockchain transaction alerts and exposure with chain, transaction hash, block/time and asset units.
Exchange originator/beneficiary information with protocol and counterparty state; delivery does not prove counterparty acceptance.
Retrieve an attributed investigation/due-diligence report with scope, author, dates, evidence and unresolved findings.
Return identity-resolution candidates and supporting identifiers; preserve candidate versus confirmed links and avoid automatic merges.
Create or manage a change subscription to a specified parent capability, datasets and scope; an active subscription is not a fresh check.
Resolve a namespaced identifier to reference records; LEI/BIC/reference identity is not beneficial ownership proof.
Acquire a versioned list/snapshot/delta with publisher, category, digest and effective time; ingesting a list does not screen a subject.
Run a governed workflow and preserve child capability results; an orchestrator is not assumed to own upstream datasets.
Validate a credential issuer, signature, trust chain, expiry and revocation state; issuance/retrieval is distinct.
Collect or retrieve versioned questionnaire responses with respondent and attestation provenance; a template is not an answered questionnaire.
Retrieve source identity fields or a stored KYC record without asserting corroboration or identity verification.
Extract text, barcode/NFC or document fields with field confidence and source pointers; extraction is not authenticity verification.
Calculate an identifier or perform syntax derivation; output must not be reported as authoritative identifier validation.
Validate vehicle identifiers/vehicle facts; this adjacent capability is not person identity verification.
Issue or manage a credential and expose its lifecycle; issuing does not independently verify underlying facts.
Upload, obtain or export documents/media and their provenance; possession of an artifact is not a check outcome.
Create/retrieve electronic signatures, receipts or attestations with scheme and signer provenance; not identity verification.
Represent a composite/custom watchlist operation whose categories are parameterized; emit atomic sanctions/PEP/media results only for evidenced categories.
Validate access/control of an account using microdeposits or account credentials; does not establish that the named subject is its legal holder.
Retrieve account metadata or holder details without a subject comparison; not account ownership verification.
Retrieve, enrich or categorize financial transactions; no AML monitoring conclusion is implied.
Retrieve balance snapshots with amount, currency, balance type and timestamp.
Retrieve or assess income/employment evidence with period, source and verification method.
Retrieve financial features, insights or credit/lending metrics; preserve provider methodology and distinguish computed features from verified evidence.
Retrieve supported financial institution, routing and merchant reference metadata; support catalogs are not customer checks.
Manage budgets, goals, tags, categories, rewards or other personal-finance resources; adjacent product functionality, not financial-crime evidence.
Retrieve questionnaire definitions/standards; a blank template is not a response or attestation.

Manage authentication, sessions, consent, subject records, webhooks, audit logs, queues, diagnostics and native controls. Require an operation_kind and, where known, enables[]; produce no intelligence assertion merely from control success.
Perform sandbox/test setup or webhook simulation; results remain explicitly synthetic and cannot satisfy a live intelligence requirement.
